about_the_game:
This DLC adds unique and possessive yandere Waifu Chie Tesla to the roster of enjoyable Waifus in Waifu Rancher 2.

Chie's unforgettable combination of sweet, possessive and mildly psychotic will certainly keep you guessing. One of the most unique Waifus, she'll have you hypnotized with her distinctive pink hair and gold eyes.

Our only advice is don't let Chie catch you together with another Waifu - she'll want to have you all to herself.

This DLC includes:

  • Playable Waifu Chie with 3 outfits

  • Over 60 new images

  • Over 100 new voice lines including over 60 lewd voice lines

content_descriptors.notes: Contains lewd voice lines, gratifying vocalizations and depictions of adult female characters in in-context, revealing outfits and poses.
